requirement_breaks: Because it hashes raw 32-byte calldata words, a non-canonical ABI encoding with dirty upper bits in the address/uint24/int24 slots can produce an ID that differs from PoolIdLibrary.toId for the same typed PoolKey.
For the same reason, the hash depends on padding or dirty bits outside the logical PoolKey values, so two calldata encodings of one logical key can map to different IDs.
